summary: The study describes the synthesis of a titanium dioxide/lithium phosphate (TLPO) nanocomposite using atomic layer deposition (ALD) at 250 °C. The ALD process combined the deposition of TiO2 and lithium phosphate (LPO) to create a nanocomposite with anatase TiO2 nanocrystals embedded in an amorphous LPO matrix. The resulting material was applied as an anode for lithium-ion batteries (LIBs), showing enhanced electrochemical performance due to the incorporation of the ionic conductive LPO component.
evidence: The ALD processes of TiO2 and LPO were applied in sequence at 250 °C to create a continuous matrix of the nanocomposite. TLPO thin film was uniformly and conformally deposited on CNTs. The electrochemical performances of CNTs@TLPO as an anode in LIBs was also compared with ALD-deposited anatase TiO2 on CNTs (designated as CNTs@T).
